group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-02: 'Bednarek AK[au]' 80, 'Bednarek AK[au] AND WWOX' 38.
group_assessment.weighting: A primary WWOX group for the GENE and not for WWOX-DEE: the Lodz department's WWOX work is cancer genetics, and this paper is bioinformatics over TCGA plus one lentiviral overexpression experiment. NOT INDEPENDENT of PMID 34204789 in this same wave — same department, same senior authors, overlapping first authors — and the two must not be counted as corroborating sources.
group_assessment.note: Department of Molecular Carcinogenesis, Medical University of Lodz -- Bednarek's group, a long-standing WWOX cancer-genetics laboratory and the same group as PMID 34204789 in this wave. The two records are NOT independent: same senior authors, same department, overlapping first authors, and this paper is the explicit follow-up of the group's own 2023 in vitro study. They must not be counted as two corroborating sources.

field_density.note: High WWOX density, zero neural-disease density. The only bench work is lentiviral WWOX overexpression plus CAGE-Seq in biological triplicate in four glioblastoma lines.

multihop.enumeration_method: <ref> elements counted in the JATS: 164. Not classified by gene-directedness.
multihop.note: ONE HOP IS LOAD-BEARING AND IS NOT TAKEN: Kaluzinska-Kolat et al. 2023, the group's own preceding paper, holds the proliferation measurement that this article only cites. Logged in the analysis note as the acquisition that would turn this lead into a datum.

corpus_crossquery.query: Does the model anywhere allow a context in which added WWOX fails to help?
corpus_crossquery.finding: No. The model's only hedge on gene therapy is that a dose may be too LOW. This paper supplies a context-dependence instance at the cell-line level and the authors refuse its causal reading, so it strengthens the case for recording the question without supplying an answer.

retraction_check.result: No retraction, no expression of concern, no erratum. Article type 'Journal Article'. The token 'retract' occurs once in the JATS, inside the reference list, not as a notice on this article.

verbatim_locators.abstract_anchoring_waived: Stated per entry. Where an entry draws on the abstract it says so in its anchor; every entry is matched against the declared artifact as a whole.
verbatim_locators.note: COVERAGE: whole article read, including the 'Study limitations' section and every figure legend. NOT INSPECTED: Supplementary Tables S1-S7 and Supplementary Figures S1-S5, which are separate files not fetched -- so the patient-group cut-off values (S2), the TIMER 2.0 estimates (S6) and the CNA table (S7) are carried only by the authors' running text. IMPORTANT PROVENANCE LIMIT recorded in the dossier: the phenotype this paper interprets -- WWOX overexpression increasing proliferation in DBTRG-05MG -- was MEASURED IN THE PRECEDING PAPER (Kaluzinska-Kolat et al. 2023, a different record not read in this wave); this paper measures CAGE-Seq transcriptomes and cites that phenotype.

entries.proposition: THE PHENOTYPE THAT MAKES THIS PAPER RELEVANT TO DOSE, AND IT IS CARRIED, NOT MEASURED HERE. Raising WWOX increased proliferation in one of four glioblastoma lines. The sentence is in the past tense and cites the preceding study; this article's own measurements are transcriptomic.
entries.snippet: proliferative potential after WWOX overexpression was increased only in DBTRG-05MG
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, section on the WWOX-related network, paragraph aligning annotations with the former study

entries.proposition: THE PAPER'S OWN HEADLINE CLAIM, STATED AT PATIENT LEVEL AND HEDGED TO A CO-OCCURRENCE RATHER THAN A CAUSE. High WWOX is not beneficial in every molecular context -- which is the generalisable half -- but the mechanism offered is other genes' profile, not WWOX itself.
entries.snippet: high WWOX expression with simultaneously elevated expression of other genes (herein: POLE4 and HSF2BP ) did not bring prognostic benefits and may be related to the more cancer-promoting profile

entries.proposition: THE AUTHORS REFUSE THE CAUSAL READING THEMSELVES. This is the sentence that forbids carrying their result as 'raising WWOX worsened outcome'.
entries.snippet: the elaborated resemblance of findings from GBM cell lines using data from GBM patients is imperfect, and it cannot be assumed that POLE4 and HSF2BP levels were elevated in patients with unfavorable outcomes due to the higher levels of WWOX
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, final paragraph of the patient-stratification section

entries.proposition: AND THEY STATE THE IN-VITRO-TO-ORGANISM LIMIT IN THEIR OWN WORDS, which is the transfer boundary that applies before any neuronal reading of this paper.
entries.snippet: the conclusions drawn from in vitro experiments may not accurately reflect the conditions within an organism

entries.proposition: No proliferation, viability or colony assay is performed in this paper: its own work is transcriptomic and network-analytic throughout.
entries.snippet: Our previous research concluded that the anti-GBM activity of WWOX is mainly a consequence of reduced cell viability and invasion
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, introductory paragraph on the GBM literature - the strings MTT, BrdU and transfect occur zero times in the article and all three occurrences of viabilit are narrative sentences about the preceding study

entries.proposition: The one-of-four exception carried from the preceding study is specifically colony growth and formation in one line.
entries.snippet: discrepancies related to colony growth and formation were noticed in one of the above GBM cell lines, i.e., DBTRG-05MG
entries.anchor: Results and discussion, introductory paragraph on the GBM literature

entries.proposition: The transduction raised WWOX in all four lines, so the one-of-four phenotype is not a failure of overexpression in the other three.

entries.anchor: Supplementary Table 5, sheet 'Up in DBTRG only'/'Up in all cell lines' block, and Supplementary Table 3, sheet 'Cell-line specific'; read cell-wise from the workbook XML
